mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_ai_result (id, task_id, result_type, content_text, structured_json, model_name, prompt_version, input_tokens, output_tokens) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{result.id}), HEXTORAW(#{result.taskId}), #{result.resultType}, #{result.contentText, jdbcType=CLOB}, CAST(#{result.structuredJson} AS JSON), #{result.modelName}, #{result.promptVersion}, #{result.inputTokens, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{result.outputTokens, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT RAWTOHEX(r.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(r.task_id) AS taskId, r.result_type AS resultType, r.content_text AS contentText, JSON_SERIALIZE(r.structured_json RETURNING CLOB) AS structuredJson, r.model_name AS modelName, r.prompt_version AS promptVersion, r.input_tokens AS inputTokens, r.output_tokens AS outputTokens FROM edudoc_ai_result r WHERE r.task_id = HEXTORAW(#{taskIdHex}) ORDER BY r.create_time DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO edudoc_ai_citation (id, result_id, chunk_id, page_no, char_start, char_end, quote_text, rank_no)
SELECT HEXTORAW(#{c.id}), HEXTORAW(#{c.resultId}), HEXTORAW(#{c.chunkId}), #{c.pageNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{c.charStart, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{c.charEnd, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{c.quoteText, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{c.rankNo} FROM DUAL
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(r.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(r.task_id) AS taskId, r.result_type AS resultType, r.content_text AS contentText, JSON_SERIALIZE(r.structured_json RETURNING CLOB) AS structuredJson, r.model_name AS modelName, r.prompt_version AS promptVersion, r.input_tokens AS inputTokens, r.output_tokens AS outputTokens FROM edudoc_ai_result r WHERE r.id = HEXTORAW(#{idHex})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM edudoc_ai_citation WHERE chunk_id IN (SELECT id FROM edudoc_document_chunk WHERE document_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{versionIdHex}))
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(c.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(c.result_id) AS resultId, RAWTOHEX(c.chunk_id) AS chunkId, c.page_no AS pageNo, c.char_start AS charStart, c.char_end AS charEnd, c.quote_text AS quoteText, c.rank_no AS rankNo FROM edudoc_ai_citation c WHERE c.result_id = HEXTORAW(#{resultIdHex}) ORDER BY c.rank_no
